content:
alex (customer-success): Customer reports intermittent 502s for hosted API /v1/generate over the last 2 hours. Happens only for some streaming requests. Provided trace id 01EC7a9f... and sample request headers.

sara (support): Can you paste the trace ID + a redacted request header snippet? Is customer in EU region? :eyes:

alex (customer-success): Trace: 01EC7a9f-... Region: hosted-eu. They say it only spikes when they send a large X-Client-Info metadata header. Example (truncated): `X-Client-Info: eyJpZCI6IjEyMyIsImNvbS5jbGllbnQiOnsiYXR0ciI6IlZlcnNpb246MjEuMCIsImN...<snip>`

mike (eng-sre): Pulled edge logs for that trace. Envoy upstream reported `upstream_reset_before_response` and nginx returned 502. Raw log excerpt:
`2026-03-16T22:04:12.123Z edge-eu-01 envoy info ... trace=01EC7a9f upstream_reset_before_response: reason="connection failure" code=502`

juan (ingress): Looks like an ingress buffer/headers limit hit. Our ingress-nginx pool has `client_header_buffer_size` ~8k by default; if X-Client-Info > 8k it can trigger a 502 when header parsing fails during streaming handoff.

sara (support): Customer says it reproduces when streaming chunked responses start. Maybe header is fine for normal requests but streaming handshake path exercises a different codepath.

mike (eng-sre): Repro locally with curl using a ~14k header and streaming attach: 

```bash
curl -v \
  -H "X-Client-Info: $(python3 -c 'print("A"*14000)')" \
  -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" \
  -d $'5\nhello\n0\n' \
  "https://api.hosted-eu.redwood.ai/v1/generate"
```

Response: 502 from frontdoor immediately, no upstream body. Confirmed on eu staging frontdoors.

alex (customer-success): Customer measures header len ~14k. They can trim but need guidance and a longer-term fix.

juan (ingress): Short-term mitigation options:
- Ask customer to move large metadata into request body or a tenant-specific metadata endpoint.
- We can increase client_header_buffer_size for hosted-eu pool to 16k temporarily (risk: memory increase per connection).

mike (eng-sre): I'll open a change request for a canary bump on two eu frontdoors and watch 5xx and memory. Deploy window 30m, rollback on >0.5% 5xx spike.

deploy-bot: Change request CR-5891 opened by mike. https://redwood-infra/changes/CR-5891

sara (support): Tell customer the immediate workaround (move header->body) and that we're testing a temporary buffer bump; request they try trimming and report back.

alex (customer-success): Forwarded to customer, they're going to try trimming and report in 30m.

juan (ingress): Config snippet (nginx) to increase buffers for reference:

```nginx
http {
  server {
    location / {
      client_header_buffer_size 16k;
      large_client_header_buffers 4 16k;
    }
  }
}
```

mike (eng-sre): Also added nginx log sampling for 502 responses to capture full header length and first 1k chars of X-Client-Info for diagnosis.

sara (support): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll keep the thread updated with customer feedback.

alex (customer-success): Customer confirmed reduced header fixed the 502 for a quick test. Staying on the ticket until CR-5891 canary completes.
